title: Downlink Cat shot list (v1)
description: What a director model writes for one Short. The builder (pipeline/engine/build.mjs) checks it with lib/validate.mjs, which applies this schema plus the rules that depend on the narration (anchors, beat order, cat choreography) and reports each problem with its path. Word anchors: "word", "word#2" (second occurrence), "word@end" (end of the word), "word+4f" / "word-6f" (frame offset), or a frame number. A word that occurs more than once must carry #n.

title.description: Page title: a name of two to four words.

bed.description: Music bed id from lab/sound/beds/beds.json (rotate: never the same bed two Shorts in a row).

captions.description: The aligner output, relative to the Short folder.

stress.description: Emphasis words of the script: the cat's mouth and head stress them.

assets.description: Every image the Short shows, by name.

beats.description: In narration order. The first is the hook, the last the NEXT card.

anchor.description: A narration word (see the top description) or a frame number.

markup.description: On-screen text. *word* is amber, _word_ is muted. Facts only: no filler labels such as "not to scale".

file.description: Path relative to the Short folder (jpg, png or webp; larger than 3200 px is downscaled).

credit.description: Exactly as the source gives it (NASA/JPL-Caltech; ESA with its required line).

kind.description: graphic: a cut-out such as an infographic icon (no parallax layers).

focus.description: The subject box [x, y, w, h] as fractions of the image. Required for photos: framing, parallax and the cat's keep-out all come from it.

crop.description: Pixel box [x, y, w, h] of the file to use (icons riding bars).

note.description: Where the image comes from (asset id, page).

number.description: The giant number block. On a photo it sits on an ink box (amber on ink).

text.description: Instead of value, for a non-numeric slam ("1/1000").

style.description: count: spring count-up from the first nonzero step; slam: the whole value; roll: an odometer from `from` to `value`.

data.description: The mono line under the number (units in _muted_).

size.description: Font px; default fits x 40 to 900, at most 340.

diagram.description: Flat amber line art in diagram units: a `size` box (default [1000, 800]) fitted into the content zone or its left or right part.

subject.description: What the cat must not cover: a unit box, "none", or (default) every drawn element.

dot.description: The persistent amber dot inside the drawing.

path.description: id of a path element the dot travels along (keys then give u, 0..1).

camera.description: Camera keys over the drawing, or follow the dot.

element.description: Exactly one of path, circle, ellipse, marker, ring, craft, label, glyph, hazards, fan. Every element also takes at, until, draw (frames to draw in, default 16), mute_at (turns muted and dashed), id.

style.description: route: dashed behind the dot, solid ahead.

ring.description: [x, y, r]; pulse: words; ink: fill inside.

hazards.description: [x, y, w, h]: seeded rocks, revealed when the dot's fan reaches them.

fan.description: A view fan on the dot, range in units.

start.description: The word the beat lands on (the transition is centred on it).

hit.description: The start word is a hit word: allows a hard cut.

transition.description: How this beat enters (none on the hook).

type.description: push: both shots travel together (camera move); iris: the outgoing closes into the amber dot, the incoming opens from it; morph: the outgoing shrinks into the dot, the incoming grows or draws in from it; cut: hit words only.

source.description: Source of the facts on line art ("NASA"); shown as "Source: NASA" in the credit slot. Required for line-art beats.

value.description: Computed from a real distance for the story date ("12 min 59 s").

seconds.description: The real delay; at 1.6 s or less the echo ring lands exactly that late.

shot.description: Parameters by type. hook: image (photo) or elements (line art) + number or headline. photo: image, frame, y, fill, zoom, push, drift, punch, layers, camera, marks, number. lens: image, side, r, fill, number. count: number + image (lens) or diagram. bars: rows, max, ticks, race, at, land, mark, dot_row. diagram: see $defs/diagram. points: stages (two). fact: lines, by, by_at, size, art. next: headline, headline_at, date (or null), date_at, lines, pointer, art.

items.description: Extra keys pass to the v3 actor (dur, count, period, text, sub, size, spin, height, scale, from).

to.description: Travel destination (feet): caption, caption:0.3, left, right, center, dot, el:<name>, el:<name>:0.3, el:<beat id>.<name>, or [x, y]. For exit zip/jet: left, right, up.

target.description: What a point, gasp or look aims at (same forms as to, plus camera).

box.description: enter pop: the box he pops up from (caption).
